match: Actual DES candidate host RA/DEC to unique nearest DES Y3 deep galaxy within1arcsec; second neighbour must be beyond same radius. Sensitivities .5 and2arcsec. Group using released deep ID, not SN position.
quality: Retain full match table with flags; default inference FLAGS=FLAGS_NIR=MASK_FLAGS=MASK_FLAGS_NIR=0, KNN_CLASS=1; positive finite errors; retain negative flux. Export less stringent subsets explicitly.
selection: Exact DES numeric CID match to frozen Dovekie metadata; all other candidates remain mixed transient/nontransient population, not rejected SNIa control. Selected vs parent is descriptive support only.
validation: Source MD5 against official Parquet JSON and independent SHA256
Selection IDs and physical galaxy duplicates preserved
Host magnitude comparisons diagnostic only; no magnitude agreement cut selected after results.
photometry: 8 bands native DECam ugriz/VISTA JHKs model flux and error, uncorrected/calibrated and dereddened/calibrated products. No interband covariance released; aperture covariance and blending caveat explicit.
statistics: Predeclared redshift bins from design.json; minimum twenty objects in a comparison. Bootstrap physical host IDs,500 draws. Colour/flux claims only in native filters with z conditioning; author restframe colors separately model dependent.
